description.fallback: Penjira loses a bet to Jiji over the timing of Menō passing by their cell. Using an almond tree branch from Ganno, Jiji lures Menō near to pet it. Jiji explains that despite not eating almonds, he always sees Menō under the almond tree, deducing it likes the scent.
